FN-9JASFBM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 180
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2025
Senate Bill 180 as introduced would prohibit any state or local governmental entity from
contracting with media monitoring organizations or any marketing or advertising agency that
uses such an organization. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
